Eglarest

A haven of the Falathrim, beside the mouth of the Nenning in the First Age

08:00Morning · Day 1
Eglarest, Círdan's people, the rebuilding with Noldorin aid, and Barad Nimras come from The Silmarillion. The harbour plan, quarters, halls and daily activities are interpretations. Existing Elven sprites stand in for the Falathrim; no named Círdan portrait is included.
